sloka: मकराक्षस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं ते निशाचराः।सर्वे नानायुधोपेता बलवन्तः समागताः ।। ६.७८.१३ ।।
transliteration: makarākṣasya tacchrutvā vacanaṁ te niśācarāḥ।sarve nānāyudhopetā balavantaḥ samāgatāḥ ।। 6.78.13 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Maka raksha's words all the mighty Rakshasas came with different kinds of weapons.
